description: Open-source AI penetration testing agent that exploit-verifies every finding. Autonomous 22-phase pentests of web apps & APIs with CVSS-scored PDF reports. Self-hosted, bring your own LLM, or run fully local with Ollama.

written.description: Runs a second, independent agent whose only job is to re-exploit what the first one claimed, so a finding is either reproduced or dropped. One self-hosted binary with a local dashboard.

alive.last_commit_message:
fix(agent): stop saying send_request goes through Caido (#930)

The full and compact checklists said every send_request call is routed
through the Caido proxy and can be reviewed with list_requests, and the
curl-preference nudges reserved send_request for requests that must
appear in the Caido log. send_request uses the configured outbound proxy
or a direct connection; only list_requests queries Caido.

- Describe the real routing in both checklists, including that
  send_request reaches Caido only when the operator's outbound proxy is
  the Caido listener, and what list_requests actually shows.
- Drop the Caido-logging justification from the send_request nudges and
  correct the list_requests tool description.
- TestSendRequestDoesNotRouteThroughCaido pins the routing;
  TestSendRequestPromptDoesNotClaimCaidoRouting guards the checklists,
  the built system prompt and the nudges.

Fixes #917
